name: Spalding County, GA
findings: Spalding County has 168 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Spalding County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 19 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 5 hobby and sports organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
